business_problem: Clean Harbors had outgrown legacy financial, HR, and sales systems that slowed collections, created cash-application errors, made incentive compensation workflows highly manual, and drove up software and maintenance costs as the company expanded through growth and acquisitions.
solution_summary: Clean Harbors standardized on Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications to replace a sprawl of standalone tools and custom integrations with one suite spanning finance, workforce, sales compensation, supply chain, and analytics. Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and EPM manage receivables, cash, planning, and financial close activities, while Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM supports recruiting and onboarding for a 25,000-person workforce. Oracle Sales Performance Management modernizes field-sales incentive processes, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure simplifies integration across data and applications. The company is also rolling out Oracle Fusion AI Data Platform to analyze hundreds of terabytes of finance and operational data and evaluate AI agents for hiring, onboarding, procurement, and close processes. This design creates a shared operational dataset that supports automation, rapid decisions, and future AI expansion without maintaining multiple disconnected systems.
products_used: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM)
Oracle Fusion Cloud Human Capital Management (HCM)

data_flow: Finance, payroll, recruiting, incentive, and operational data flow into Oracle Fusion applications on a shared cloud platform; OCI integration keeps the modules synchronized; Oracle Fusion AI Data Platform analyzes hundreds of terabytes from those systems so teams can run dashboards, natural-language queries, and AI agents across close, hiring, onboarding, procurement, and logistics workflows.
business_outcome: Clean Harbors reduced annual software and maintenance costs by more than $1 million, improved cash performance and workforce metrics, and created a unified operating model that supports faster decisions today and AI-driven automation across finance, HR, procurement, and logistics next.
